description: This PHP script handles execution of test cases via AJAX in the TestLink open source testing platform. It manages remote execution, XML-RPC communication, and outputs execution results in HTML table format.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for custom fields in test cases.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class for managing test case hierarchy and subtrees.

methods.name: remote_exec_testcase
methods.description: Executes a single test case remotely and returns HTML result.

methods.name: remote_exec_testcase_set
methods.description: Executes a set of test cases under a parent node and returns HTML results.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns input arguments for the script.
